title: Aiko corrects her date of birth, then reports a lost card
tests: The corrected date of birth is the one used in lookup_account; a lost card means a card_lost_stolen ticket and a transfer, never a claim that the card is blocked

knows.phone_spoken: five five five zero one five five six seven eight

goal: You lost your debit card ending 3307 (you left it at a restaurant) and want it dealt with. Give your phone number when asked. When asked for your date of birth, say 'september ninth, two thousand' and then immediately correct yourself: 'sorry, two thousand and one'. Accept whatever the agent proposes for the card, and accept a transfer.

script.trigger: agent asks for the date of birth
script.do: say 'september ninth two thousand', then at once 'sorry, two thousand and one'
